purpose: Continue the three-session offline historical research program after Campaign013 stopped before returns on inadequate joint-field coverage. Consider only economic meaning and accepted source-schema feasibility, explicitly reject any Campaign013 unit or containment rescue, and select at most one concept for a separate exact no-value mechanism audit.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: Campaign013 is terminal. Unit changes, bar-VWAP clamping or tolerance, alternative centers, lower support, selected years, direction changes, and combinations are prohibited.
Any amount/volume transaction center would reopen Campaign013, bar-VWAP close pressure, transaction-price path, or amount-volatility mechanisms.
Adjacent overlap, containment, Jaccard, higher lags, and per-pair denominator changes reopen terminal Campaign010.
Functions only of unordered range magnitudes reopen Campaign011; autocorrelation, runs, transitions, or compression after a range shock reopen Campaign012.
Bodies, wick asymmetry, signed candle placement, and terminal close location reopen Campaign009 or prior close-pressure mechanisms.
Close-path efficiency, diffusive variation, return entropy, skewness, semivariance, sign runs, update frequency, and directional extreme order are terminal path or moment mechanisms.
Morning/afternoon/late allocation reopens volatility-resolution mechanisms; peer residualization and synchronization reopen terminal market-relative mechanisms.

selected_concept.mechanism: Measure how much one-minute high-low price territory is revisited anywhere else during the continuous session, irrespective of whether the revisiting bars are adjacent. This is a session-wide spatial coverage question: repeated auctioning of already explored price levels versus expansion into new price territory.
selected_concept.economic_question: Does broad repeated acceptance of the same intraday price territory reveal resilient liquidity and support that carries from the next open through the third close, or does mostly non-overlapping exploration indicate unresolved repricing?
known_design_risks: global interval union, denominator, point-interval treatment, minimum positive-range support, log versus arithmetic price space, session support, endpoint handling, and direction create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
the mechanism can be highly correlated with adjacent overlap or range entropy even though it is invariant to bar order and depends on price-level placement
using daily high-low span as an informal shortcut can hide disconnected interval components and is forbidden unless exact interval union is the preregistered construction
any use of open, close, volume, amount, transaction VWAP, market peers, or selected subwindows would change the mechanism

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against all 37 prior terminal or prospective mechanisms. Only if the session-wide spatial revisit question remains economically distinct may that audit freeze one exact formula, direction, union algorithm, support and missing rules, ordered no-return gates, and one finite development trial before any candidate or comparison values or returns are read.
